Scarletta pizzas are baked on stone to give an extra crispy base and puffy crust. Topped with a selection of marinated and grilled vegetables and a little pesto for extra flavour. Our Pizzas made with a 72 hour pizza dough for extra flavour. 
Made to fit toaster ovens and large air fryers, as well as ovens. Simply bake/ air fry straight from the freezer on high for 7-10 minutes, or until crispy and the cheese is golden. All appliances have a personality of their own, so times and temperatures do vary.
(Frozen 400g)
